purpose: Fix what the app is made of, what must still work after a later edit, and keep the record current without touching the fields the server owns.

questions.question: Which files is this app made of, and which one opens first?
Of what tells you it worked, what must still be true after a future edit? (prefilled from P3; correct it if the regression check is narrower)
What is the smallest real example it has to handle, and what does it show for it?
Is anything in here temporary that a future edit should not trust?

artifact: the Engineering rows and the ## Changes list in APP.md; the frameworkKit stamp is displayed here but written by the server

rules.rule: The folder is the app and module.json is its manifest: id equals the folder name, and schema, id, name, kind, status, version are always present.
Content files first and module.json last, complete, in one write. A folder with no manifest is not listed; a manifest caught mid-write renders as a building row.
rules.enforced_by: the panel row is the proof; server materialization writes the manifest last

rules.rule: version and updated_ms belong to the server. The chat never bumps or writes them. An accepted migration is not an edit: it writes the two stamp copies only.
rules.enforced_by: C21; the server owns the bump; test_kit_upgrade.py

rules.rule: The chat never writes events. Every app.created and app.edited row is the server's.
rules.enforced_by: C18 (no hand-written event file in the folder)

rules.rule: Only module.json, index.html and assets/** travel when the app is shared. APP.md stays on this machine, which is why the stamp is mirrored into the manifest.
rules.enforced_by: C18 names the non-travelling files; C20 checks the mirror

rules.rule: Size caps: at most 200 files, 5 MB per file, 20 MB total, and a page's index.html at most 512 KB.
rules.enforced_by: C19, reading the constants from the runtime

rules.rule: Sharing needs manifest schema 2. A schema 1 app is never rewritten in bulk; it bumps itself on its next edit.
rules.enforced_by: C24, advisory until P7 names someone else

rules.rule: Fields the kit adds to module.json are carried through untouched on every read and write back, which is the only reason the stamp can live there.
rules.enforced_by: read-time normalize is a projection; C20

rules.rule: The stamp is written once, at create, by the server. A newer plugin exposes a newer kit to new apps only; an existing app keeps its kit until its owner accepts a migration in Edit.
rules.enforced_by: server write path plus the upgrade no-rewrite test; C20 checks presence and agreement

rules.rule: Every edit session appends one dated line to ## Changes.
On import, the server reconstructs an APP.md skeleton from module.json plus the mirrored stamp; every answer it cannot recover is written as 'not recorded'.
rules.enforced_by: deferred to the Publish program (design v1 scope R1-P6); C1 reports 'not recorded' cells as WARN

checks.what: module.json parses, carries the required keys with the right types, and its id equals the folder name.
checks.evaluator: json.load then jsonschema against app-manifest.schema.json (falling back to the explicit key and type checks of modules_pkg.validate_manifest); id == basename, matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$, not sys-

checks.what: The folder holds only the files this kind is allowed, plus APP.md, and no hand-written event log.
checks.evaluator: walk ignoring dot directories; per-kind allow set (page: module.json, index.html, assets/**; chat: module.json, data-policy.json; link: module.json) plus APP.md; anything else named as 'will not travel'; a *.events.* file FAILs
count members and stat sizes against MAX_MEMBERS, MAX_FILE, MAX_TOTAL from modules_pkg; a page's index.html against HTML_MAX from modules_api

checks.what: The stamp is present on the APP.md header line and mirrored in module.json, and the two agree.
checks.evaluator: first non-blank APP.md line matches ^frameworkKit: \{.*\}$ and parses; module.json.frameworkKit parses; version, digest (12 hex) and created_at agree; installed kit newer than the stamp is WARN never FAIL

checks.what: The fields the server owns were not hand-written.
checks.evaluator: version is an int >= 1; updated_ms absent or an int; drift comparison is left to the server

checks.what: The E2 regression check names something a person can open and see after an edit.
checks.evaluator: cell >= 12 characters, one verb from the open set (open, click, paste, reopen, read, run) and one from the observe set (see, reads, shows, lands, top row, asks); a cell identical to P3 passes when it satisfies the shape

checks.what: The newest ## Changes line is dated and not older than the manifest's updated_at.
checks.evaluator: first bullet under ## Changes starts with YYYY-MM-DD; parsed date >= date(updated_at)

checks.what: schema is 2, which export requires; blocking once P7 names someone besides the builder.
checks.evaluator: raw.get('schema') == 2; the failure quotes the export refusal wording; the profile promotes the level from the P7 answer
